job: Land to Rear of 1-8 Wesley Terrace, Castleside

stages.title: Footings
stages.desc: Stepped Nudura ICF footing walls under every block, following the site levels (6in XR35 external, 6in Standard party walls; 2 to 5 courses below FFL), the indicative ground-floor slabs, and the 10G site plan draped on the survey levels.

stages.title: Ground-floor ICF, partitions, windows and doors
stages.desc: Ground-floor ICF walls with the openings (25 mm head and jamb overfly), ground-floor timber stud partitions (38x89 C16), UPVC windows and doors.

stages.title: First floor
stages.desc: 253 mm metal-web joists spanning gable to party wall, top-hung on cut-down ledgers fixed to the ICF with Strong-Tie connectors, 22 mm Egger Protect deck (toggle), timber stairs.

stages.title: First-floor ICF, partitions and windows
stages.desc: First-floor ICF walls to the eaves at 5,320 mm, the gables and party walls to the roof line, first-floor timber stud partitions, UPVC windows.

stages.title: Roof structure
stages.desc: Fink trussed rafters at 600 centres with gable ladders on the houses; bungalow hip roofs: 2-ply girder trusses at the hip ends with Fink trusses between, hip ends framed loose with hips, crown and jack rafters (for the manufacturer to price as jack trusses).
